company.name: Hakeem
company.shortDescription: Hakeem is a digital healthcare and telepharmacy platform that provides pharmacy and clinical support solutions for patients.
company.description: Hakeem is a healthcare technology company based in the United Arab Emirates that develops digital pharmacy and telehealth infrastructure for healthcare providers, insurers, and patients. The company operates a platform focused on prescription management, medication dispensing, telepharmacy services, and home delivery of medicines. Its services are designed to support hospitals, clinics, and healthcare organizations with pharmacy operations, patient engagement, and medication access through integrated digital systems. Hakeem Health also provides tools for electronic prescriptions, healthcare coordination, and logistics management within the regional healthcare ecosystem.
